claims.statement: Monitoring uses the canonical missions model; the experimental monitoringJobs model is not registered.
Workbench endpoints are read-only semantic projections of canonical runtime records and do not create a parallel scheduler or data model.
The application opens on one compact role-aware home with one contextual primary action, a four-step horizontal journey and two distinct operational paths.
The rendered experience uses server-issued capabilities for write affordances and provides compact mobile, keyboard and touch-safe presentation rules.
Auditor access remains read-only, does not impersonate an administrator and exposes evidence through the active auditor identity.

The repository contains an executable 18-dimension enterprise assurance model with per-dimension N+15 saturation, universal invariant convergence, source probes, selected runtime stress and explicit falsification; it does not certify deployment controls.
Deployment certification requires external identity, TLS, storage, backup, malware scanning, observability and accessibility evidence.
